claim: Information technology creates a dilemma for authoritarian control.
originalWording: Information technology creates a dilemma for authoritarian control.

sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Age of Intelligent Machines excerpts, printed pp. 127–128; original-book pp. 445–447

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Information technology makes authoritarian information control harder while also enabling governments to respond.
reference.rationale: This is a conditional, undated societal forecast; no invented 1991 deadline is used. Global information access creates real pressures, but digital repression and persistent authoritarian control prevent a simple democracy-caused-by-technology verdict.
